name: WE_XWE
title: XWE from ABE laws (BJKPW17 Thm. 3.2): the ABE laws, the XWE ciphertext law and the per-ciphertext hybrids
description: AdvancedEncryption.WE.XWE: ABELaws (setup, key for a key half v, enc of a bit under an attribute w, as PMF kernels), seqLaw (independent samples from a list of laws), ctLaw (setup, all keys for W1, all ciphertexts for W2 with bit i for the i-th attribute, encoded as a tuple and post-processed by a fixed map), xweLaw (the XWE encryption of a bit beta) and hybLaw j (the first j attributes encrypt true). Following Brakerski-Jain-Komargodski-Passelegue-Wichs, ePrint 2017/874, Theorem 3.2, with an arbitrary (unbalanced) split.
